# Variable aliases for the common position / hitstun / hitstop / hit / status / motion variables (tools/position_vars_cave.py,
# docs/position-variables.md). Generated by make_tooltips.py: put your own in custom.txt.
# Combat variables: TARGET_QUANTITY, TARGET = SELF, OPP (nearest opponent), LASTHIT (last fighter
# hit), SLOT1-SLOT8; QUANTITY = HITSTUN, HITSTUN_DEALT, HITSTUN_MUL, HITSTOP_SHAKE, HITSTOP, OFFSET_X, OFFSET_Y, OFFSET_Z, HIT, HIT_NOW, STATUS, MOTION, MOTION_FRAME.

POS_SELF_X             = 0x0F000000   # this fighter's X
POS_SELF_Y             = 0x0F000001
POS_SELF_Z             = 0x0F000002
POS_SELF_FACING        = 0x0F000003   # 1 right, -1 left (read only)
POS_SELF_MOVE_FWD      = 0x0F000004   # write: move forward by the value
POS_SELF_MOVE_UP       = 0x0F000005   # write: move up by the value
POS_SELF_MOVE_Z        = 0x0F000006   # write: move along Z by the value
POS_OPP_X              = 0x0F000008   # nearest opponent's X
POS_OPP_Y              = 0x0F000009
POS_OPP_Z              = 0x0F00000A
POS_OPP_DIST           = 0x0F00000B   # X/Y distance to the nearest opponent (read only)
POS_OPP_OFFSET_X       = 0x0F00000C   # opponent X - self X along self's facing; write: put the opponent there
POS_OPP_OFFSET_Y       = 0x0F00000D
POS_OPP_OFFSET_Z       = 0x0F00000E
POS_SELF_OFFSET_X      = 0x0F000010   # self X - opponent X along self's facing; write: put self there
